title: Google Sheets Filter Changed Everyone's View? Use THIS #Shorts
description:
Did your Google Sheets filter hide rows for teammates? Use a filter view to work with your own filtered view without changing everyone else's display.

Original diagrams and synthetic English narration; not a real account or software screen capture. Official source: https://support.google.com/docs/answer/3540681 #FlowMinuteLab #TechTips

scenes.title: MY FILTER HID YOUR ROWS
scenes.narration: A normal Google Sheets filter can affect what collaborators see. A filter view is useful when you want your own view.

scenes.title: FILTER VIEW MODE
scenes.narration: Google's help explains filter views let you sort and filter without changing another person's view of the spreadsheet.

scenes.title: OPEN FILTER VIEW
scenes.narration: In Google Sheets on a computer, open Data and create a filter view. Menu names may vary by version.

scenes.title: SAVE A VIEW
scenes.narration: Give the filter view a descriptive name so you can use it again. You can also share its link.

scenes.title: DO NOT DELETE ROWS
scenes.narration: Filtering hides rows from your selected view; it does not erase their data. Double-check before deleting anything.
